name: woocommerce/orders-query
label: Query orders
description: Find orders by ID or common order filters.

name: woocommerce/order-add-note
label: Add order note
description: Add a note to an order.

name: woocommerce/order-notes-query
label: Query order notes
description: List every note of an order, newest first.

name: woocommerce/order-send-email
label: Send order email
description: Send an order email to the customer again.

name: woocommerce/order-update
label: Update order
description: Update the addresses, customer note, product lines and shipping lines of an order. Fields that are not sent keep their value. Changing lines recalculates the totals and needs an order status that allows editing. Use the woocommerce/order-update-status ability to change the status.

name: woocommerce/payment-gateways-query
label: Query payment gateways
description: List the payment gateways in checkout order, enabled or not, or get one by ID.

name: woocommerce/products-query
label: Query products
description: Find products by ID or common catalog filters.

name: woocommerce/product-terms-query
label: Query product terms
description: Find product categories, tags, brands or the terms of a global attribute, such as pa_color. Use include to retrieve specific term IDs.

name: woocommerce/product-reviews-query
label: Query product reviews
description: Read product reviews, ratings and moderation status. Search matches review text only, never reviewer identity. Summary and per-product ranking cover all reviews in the requested product/status scope, ignoring search, rating range and include. Unrated reviews have rating zero and do not affect averages. Ranking is worst first; above 200 products it keeps the 100 worst and 100 best rated. Text searches omit the ranking. Requested products without reviews and unknown product IDs are reported separately. Reviewer identity is withheld.

name: woocommerce/product-attributes-query
label: Query product attributes
description: Find the global product attributes, such as Color or Size, with their terms. Use include to retrieve specific attribute IDs.

name: woocommerce/product-attribute-create
label: Create product attribute
description: Create a global product attribute, such as Color or Size. Product writes then use it by ID or name, with global set to true, and create its terms from the options they send.

name: woocommerce/product-create
label: Create product
description: Create a product using supported catalog fields.

name: woocommerce/product-delete
label: Delete product
description: Move a product to the trash, or delete it permanently.

name: woocommerce/product-update
label: Update product
description: Update an existing product using supported catalog fields.

name: woocommerce/shipping-zones-query
label: Query shipping zones
description: List shipping zones in matching order, with the regions each covers and its shipping methods. Zone 0 covers every location no other zone matches.

name: woocommerce/tax-rates-query
label: Query tax rates
description: List the tax rates of every tax class, in the order of the tax settings.
